phase: Phase P4+ - Hunting Trip Logger & Password Reset Testing
summary: HUNTIQ V3 Hunting Trip Logger module and Password Reset flow fully tested. All 27 backend API tests passed (100%). Trip CRUD, observations, waypoint visits, statistics, and data sync to analytics_engine all working correctly. Password reset email is LOGGED ONLY (no RESEND_API_KEY configured).

features_tested.notes: Returns module info: hunting_trip_logger v1.0.0, phase P4+
Creates new hunting trip with target_species, planned_date, title, notes. Returns trip_id
Starts trip with weather data (actual_weather, temperature, wind_speed). Sets status to in_progress
Ends trip, calculates duration, counts observations, syncs to analytics_engine
Lists user trips with optional status filter (planned, in_progress, completed)
Returns currently active trip (status=in_progress) or {active: false}
Returns full trip details by ID
Logs observations (sighting, tracks, sounds, signs, harvest) with species, count, distance, behavior
Lists observations with filters (trip_id, waypoint_id, species)
Logs waypoint visits with activity_level (0-10), weather, notes
Lists waypoint visits with optional waypoint_id filter
Returns comprehensive stats: total_trips, success_rate, total_hours, by_species, by_weather, by_month
Completed trips automatically sync to analytics_trips collection. Verified in backend logs.
Always returns success to prevent email enumeration. Email is LOGGED ONLY (no RESEND_API_KEY)
Returns {valid: true/false, email: ...}. Invalid tokens correctly rejected
Validates token, enforces min 6 char password, updates password hash
Create -> Start -> Log Observation -> End -> Check Statistics - all working
Trip logger endpoints work without auth using default_user fallback

critical_code_review_comments: Hunting trip logger properly syncs completed trips to analytics_trips collection
Email service correctly falls back to logging when RESEND_API_KEY is not configured
Password reset tokens expire after 1 hour and are marked as used after successful reset
Statistics calculation handles edge cases (no trips, no visits) gracefully
All endpoints support fallback auth via get_user_id_with_fallback helper
